reason: Filling the oxygen tank is the only remaining gameplay action offered and advances the goal.
expectation: I expect liquid oxygen to transfer through its separate line into the ascent oxygen tank.

reaction: The separate oxygen-clean line made the distinction between fuel and oxidizer clear, though the result was expected.

mostWorthwhile.text: Filling the methane tank was the most worthwhile moment: its rising indicator gave the long production effort a tangible payoff.

leastWorthwhile.text: Filling the oxygen tank felt routine because it was the only remaining action and closely mirrored the first transfer.

surprise.text: Nothing in this chapter particularly surprised me; both transfers worked as expected.

arbitrary.text: Neither transfer felt arbitrary: each served the stated goal, although their order seemed inconsequential.

continue.text: I would continue to see whether the discovery reaches Earth, though this chapter's straightforward transfers offered little decision-making.
